40: @Provides
41: public class SneakyThrowsRemover implements PostCompilerTransformation {
42: 	
43: 	@Override public byte[] applyTransformations(byte[] original, String fileName, final DiagnosticsReceiver diagnostics) {
44: 		if (!new ClassFileMetaData(original).usesMethod("lombok/Lombok", "sneakyThrow")) return null;
45: 		
46: 		byte[] fixedByteCode = fixJSRInlining(original);
47: 		
48: 		ClassReader reader = new ClassReader(fixedByteCode);
49: 		ClassWriter writer = new ClassWriter(reader, 0);
50: 
51: 		final AtomicBoolean changesMade = new AtomicBoolean();
52: 		
53: 		class SneakyThrowsRemoverVisitor extends MethodVisitor {
54: 			SneakyThrowsRemoverVisitor(MethodVisitor mv) {
55: 				super(Opcodes.ASM9, mv);
56: 			}
57: 			
58: 			private boolean methodInsnQueued = false;
59: 			
60: 			@Override public void visitMethodInsn(int opcode, String owner, String name, String desc, boolean itf) {
61: 				if (
62: 						opcode == Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC &&
63: 						"sneakyThrow".equals(name) &&
64: 						"lombok/Lombok".equals(owner) &&
65: 						"(Ljava/lang/Throwable;)Ljava/lang/RuntimeException;".equals(desc)) {
66: 					
67: 					if (System.getProperty("lombok.debugAsmOnly", null) != null) {
68: 						super.visitMethodInsn(opcode, owner, name, desc, itf); // DEBUG for issue 470!
69: 					} else {
70: 						methodInsnQueued = true;
71: 					}
72: 				} else {
73: 					super.visitMethodInsn(opcode, owner, name, desc, itf);
74: 				}
75: 			}
76: 			
77: 			private void handleQueue() {
78: 				if (!methodInsnQueued) return;
79: 				super.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, "lombok/Lombok", "sneakyThrow", "(Ljava/lang/Throwable;)Ljava/lang/RuntimeException;", false);
80: 				methodInsnQueued = false;
81: 				diagnostics.addWarning("Proper usage is: throw lombok.Lombok.sneakyThrow(someException);. You did not 'throw' it. Because of this, the call to sneakyThrow " +
82: 						"remains in your classfile and you will need lombok.jar on the classpath at runtime.");
83: 			}
84: 			
85: 			@Override public void visitInsn(int arg0) {
86: 				if (methodInsnQueued && arg0 == Opcodes.ATHROW) {
87: 					changesMade.set(true);
88: 					// As expected, the required ATHROW. We can now safely 'eat' the previous call.
89: 					methodInsnQueued = false;
90: 				}

92: 				super.visitInsn(arg0);
93: 			}

97: 			}

102: 			}

112: 			}
113:

122: 			}
123:

126: 				super.visitLabel(arg0);
127: 			}
128: 			
129: 			@Override public void visitJumpInsn(int arg0, Label arg1) {
130: 				handleQueue();

132: 			}
133: 			
134: 			@Override public void visitLdcInsn(Object arg0) {

137: 			}

139: 			@Override public void visitLocalVariable(String arg0, String arg1, String arg2, Label arg3, Label arg4, int arg5) {
